verdict.rationale: ClickHouse OSS is fully free and open-source (single-binary install, clickhouse-local runs real SQL workloads keylessly per probe evidence), so a founder can prototype without any paywall using the self-hosted/local path. However, ClickHouse Cloud (the managed offering most founders would actually want to prototype against before committing to ops) is not documented as having a perpetual free tier — pricing docs mention scale-to-zero and pay-per-use but no explicit free-tier/trial credit details are in evidence. missing for 10: explicit ClickHouse Cloud free-tier terms/limits, evidence of a no-cost trial credit or always-free managed tier, and independent/community confirmation that the free tier is 'genuinely usable' for real prototypes rather than just OSS self-hosting.
